_说明: 中英文切换 v1（外部文件层）：中文原文 -> 英文。{0} {1} ... 是占位：原文里那个位置是什么（数字、名字），英文里同号的位置就填什么（名字也会被翻译）。没写进来的中文会原样显示——tests 的英文检查会把它们列出来。改英文措辞只改这里。用词表见 docs/design/中英文切换-方案-v1.md 第三节。

lines.和师兄切磋：闪避一次、反击一次，再赢下切磋: Spar with Senior Brother: dodge once, counter once, then win
lines.指引 1/5：找师兄切磋，闪避、反击，赢一场: Tutorial 1/5: Spar with Senior Brother — dodge, counter, win

lines.指引 4/5：去厨房找厨娘说说话: Tutorial 4/5: Talk to Auntie Cook in the kitchen

lines.山路草丛: the grass by the mountain road
lines.最近村里接连丢鸡，有人在山路边的草丛里看见一只插着鸡毛的黄鼠狼。它跑得快，血掉到: Chickens keep vanishing from the village. Someone spotted a weasel with a feather in its cap in the grass by the mountain road. It's fast — at half health it runs, then comes back for more.
lines.山路石坎: the rocky ledge on the mountain road
lines.山路石坎上有三个狼山贼拦路收钱。三个一起上，要绕着打，别被围住。: Three wolf bandits are shaking down travelers at the rocky ledge. They attack together — keep moving and don't get surrounded.
lines.后山竹林深处: the depths of the bamboo grove
lines.山贼的老大黑虎躲在后山竹林深处。他力气大、出手重，被逼急了会发怒，出招更快，还会: Black Tiger, the bandit chief, hides deep in the bamboo grove. He's strong and hits hard — push him and he flies into a rage, attacking faster and pouncing.
lines.山路上又来了两个狼山贼，去把他们赶走。: Two more wolf bandits are on the mountain road. Go drive them off.
lines.今天茶客多，劳烦去门里的小食摊取一笼馒头，送到村口茶摊。: Lots of customers today. Could you fetch a basket of buns from your sect's food stall and bring it to the tea stall at the village gate?
lines.馒头一上桌就卖光了，多谢{0}兄弟！: The buns sold out the moment they hit the table. Thanks, {0}!
lines.去小食摊取馒头: Get buns from the food stall
lines.把馒头送到村口茶摊: Bring the buns to the tea stall
lines.回告示榜交差: Hand in at the notice board
lines.有封信要带给山门的老伯，我这儿走不开，劳烦少侠跑一趟。: There's a letter for Old Uncle at the sect gate. I can't leave the stall — would you run it up, young hero?
lines.老伯托人捎话：信收到了，替他谢谢你。: Old Uncle sent word: he got the letter, and says thank you.
lines.找茶摊老板拿信: Get the letter from the tea stall keeper
lines.把信送给山门的老伯: Bring the letter to Old Uncle at the gate
lines.我家的小鸡跑丢了，好像钻进了山路边的草丛。找到它，它会跟着你回来。: My chick ran off — I think it slipped into the grass by the mountain road. Find it and it'll follow you back.
lines.小鸡回来了！咯咯直叫，像是在谢你呢。: The chick's back! All that clucking — I think it's thanking you.
lines.去山路草丛找鸡: Find the chick in the grass by the road
lines.带小鸡回村口: Bring the chick back to the village gate
lines.后山竹林这几天冒笋了，地上发亮的地方就是。挖三根回来，晚上做笋汤。: Shoots are coming up in the bamboo grove — look for the glinting spots. Dig up three for tonight's soup.
lines.笋真嫩！今晚的汤有你一碗。: So tender! There's a bowl of soup for you tonight.
lines.我在后山竹林里丢了一块玉佩，是家里传下来的。草里有亮光的地方，就是它。: I lost a jade pendant in the bamboo grove — a family heirloom. Where something glints in the grass, that's it.
lines.就是这块！真不知道怎么谢你才好。: That's the one! I don't know how to thank you.
lines.去竹林找玉佩: Find the pendant in the grove
lines.村口东边的篱笆坏了三处，鸡老往外跑。劳烦你去补一补。: The fence east of the village gate is broken in three places and the chickens keep escaping. Could you patch it?
lines.篱笆补得结结实实，这下鸡跑不出去了。: The fence is solid now — no more runaway chickens.
lines.补村口东边的篱笆 {0}/{1}: Mend the fence east of the gate {0}/{1}
lines.嘿嘿，鸡是我偷的，又怎么样？: Heh heh, sure I stole the chickens. So what?
lines.村里人养几只鸡不容易，跟我回去认个错。: Those villagers work hard for their chickens. Come back with me and apologize.
lines.想抓我？先追得上我再说！: Wanna catch me? Gotta keep up first!
lines.又来啦？你这兔子还真不死心。: You again? This rabbit just won't quit.
lines.哎哟哎哟，别打了！鸡我不偷了，再也不偷了……: Ow, ow, stop! I'll stop stealing chickens, I swear...
lines.讨平了偷鸡的黄鼠狼！回村口的江湖告示榜交榜领赏。: The chicken-thief weasel is dealt with! Claim the reward at the Jianghu Notice Board.
lines.嘻嘻，就这点本事？回去再练练吧！: Hee hee, that's all you've got? Go practice some more!
lines.生命掉到两成，败下阵来。生命已经回满，黄鼠狼还在原地，随时可以再去。: Down to 20% HP — you lost this one. HP is restored; the weasel is still there, so go again anytime.
lines.又是你这只兔子！上回在山路上让你占了便宜。: You again, rabbit! You got lucky on the mountain road last time.
lines.今天我们三个一起上，看你往哪儿躲！: Today it's three of us — let's see where you hide!
lines.又送上门来了？兄弟们，围上！: Back for more? Boys, surround him!
lines.撤、撤！这兔子邪门得很……快回去告诉老大！: R-retreat! This rabbit's uncanny... tell the boss!
lines.赶走了拦路的山贼！回村口的江湖告示榜交榜领赏。: The roadblock bandits are gone! Claim the reward at the Jianghu Notice Board.
lines.三个打一个，你还想赢？哈哈！: Three on one and you thought you'd win? Ha!
lines.生命掉到两成，败下阵来。生命已经回满，山贼还在石坎上，随时可以再去。别被他们围住: Down to 20% HP — you lost this one. HP is restored; the bandits are still on the ledge. Go again anytime, and don't get surrounded.
lines.就是你？在山路上赶跑了我的人，又打散了狼兄弟。: So it's you? The one who ran off my men on the road and scattered the wolf brothers.
lines.你就是山贼老大黑虎？村里人的东西，你们抢够了。: You're Black Tiger, the bandit chief? You've stolen enough from the villagers.
lines.哼，这破落山门才剩几个人，一个小徒弟也敢来竹林撒野？: Hmph. That run-down sect barely has anyone left, and a little apprentice dares make trouble in my grove?
lines.来吧，让黑虎爷爷看看你有几斤几两！: Come on, let Grandpa Black Tiger see what you're made of!
lines.还敢回来？好，这回别再趴下了。: You dare come back? Fine — try not to end up flat on your face this time.
lines.山路上的兄弟，我会带走。这片山，我们以后不来了。: I'll take my men off the mountain road. We won't come back to these hills.
lines.说到做到。再让我在山路上碰见，可就不是今天这样了。: Keep your word. If I meet you on that road again, it won't end like today.
lines.讨平了山贼老大黑虎！回村口的江湖告示榜交榜领赏。: Bandit chief Black Tiger is beaten! Claim the reward at the Jianghu Notice Board.
lines.哈哈哈！小徒弟，回去叫你师父来吧！: Ha ha ha! Run home, little apprentice, and fetch your Master!
lines.生命掉到两成，败下阵来。生命已经回满，黑虎还在竹林深处。他发怒后会扑人，看准前摇: Down to 20% HP — you lost this one. HP is restored; Black Tiger is still deep in the grove. When enraged he pounces — watch the wind-up, then dodge.
lines.这条山路是我们的地盘！识相的留下买路钱！: This road is our turf! Pay the toll if you know what's good for you!
lines.跑、快跑！是打跑老大的那只兔子！: Run, run! It's the rabbit who beat the boss!
lines.巡山完成！回江湖告示榜交榜领赏。: Patrol complete! Claim the reward at the Jianghu Notice Board.
lines.生命掉到两成，败下阵来。生命已经回满，山贼还在山路上，随时可以再去。: Down to 20% HP — you lost this one. HP is restored; the bandits are still on the road. Go again anytime.
lines.茶摊老板要的馒头？刚出笼的，拿好，别凉了。: Buns for the tea stall keeper? Fresh from the steamer — hold them carefully and don't let them cool.
lines.拿到一笼馒头。送到村口茶摊。: Got a basket of buns. Bring it to the tea stall at the village gate.
lines.哎呀，馒头来了！热乎的，正好配茶。辛苦你啦，{0}兄弟。: Ah, the buns are here! Still warm — perfect with tea. Thanks for the trouble, {0}.
lines.馒头送到了。回江湖告示榜交差。: Buns delivered. Hand in at the Jianghu Notice Board.
lines.这封信劳烦你带给山门的老伯，是他山外的老朋友托我转交的。: Please take this letter to Old Uncle at the sect gate. An old friend of his from afar asked me to pass it on.
lines.拿到一封信。送到山门的老伯那里。: Got a letter. Bring it to Old Uncle at the sect gate.
lines.信？给我的？……哈哈，是老伙计写来的。难为你跑这一趟。: A letter? For me? ...Ha ha, it's from an old friend. Thanks for making the trip.
lines.信送到了。回江湖告示榜交差。: Letter delivered. Hand in at the Jianghu Notice Board.
lines.咯咯哒！小鸡歪着头看了你一会儿，扑扑翅膀，跟在你身后。: Cluck cluck! The chick tilts its head at you, flaps its wings, and falls in behind you.
lines.小鸡跟着你走。带它回村口。: The chick is following you. Bring it back to the village gate.
lines.草丛里有一块温润的玉佩，系着褪了色的红绳。: A smooth jade pendant lies in the grass, tied with a faded red cord.
lines.找到了玉佩。回江湖告示榜交差。: Found the pendant. Hand in at the Jianghu Notice Board.
lines.你就是那位打退山贼的少侠吧！村里人都在说你呢。: You're the young hero who drove off the bandits! The whole village is talking about you.
lines.以后村里有什么难事，还得请{0}兄弟多帮衬。: Whenever the village is in a fix, we'll be counting on you, {0}.
lines.来碗茶歇歇脚？村口的江湖告示榜上常有活计，去看看吧。: Rest your feet with some tea? There's often work on the Jianghu Notice Board by the gate — take a look.
lines.哟，少侠来啦！如今十里八乡都听说过你的名号。: Oh, the young hero is here! Your name is known for miles around now.
lines.这碗茶算我请的。告示榜上的委托，托付人都说给你的工钱要多给些。: This tea's on me. Folks posting errands on the board all say you deserve extra pay.
lines.江湖告示榜：左边红纸是悬赏，右边黄纸是委托。: Jianghu Notice Board: red notices on the left are Bounties, yellow ones on the right are Errands.

lines.出招更快，小心扑击: Faster attacks — watch for the pounce

lines.{0}来啦。你从竹林里找回来的瓦，我一片片都码好了。: Here comes {0}. I've stacked every tile you brought back from the grove.
lines.宿舍那屋顶，破洞可不小。下雨天，你那木桶接得过来吗？: That dorm roof has a big hole. When it rains, can your bucket keep up?
lines.接不过来……昨晚还漫了一地。: It can't... it flooded the floor last night.
lines.瓦是现成的，就收个工钱，{0} 文。今天就给你补上。: I've got the tiles, so just my labor: {0} coins. I'll patch it today.
lines.花 {0} 铜钱请老周修屋顶？: Pay {0} coins for Old Zhou to fix the roof?
lines.不急不急，想好了再来找我。我就在这儿晒晒太阳。: No rush. Come back when you've decided — I'll be here in the sun.
lines.钱不够也不打紧，我就在这儿，凑够了再来。: Short on coins? No matter. I'll be right here — come back when you have enough.
lines.补好了！新瓦压旧瓦，往后下多大的雨，屋里都是干的。: All patched! New tiles over old — however hard it rains, it'll stay dry inside.
lines.谢谢老周！木桶也能收起来了。: Thank you, Old Zhou! I can put the bucket away now.
lines.你师祖当年背我蹚过大水，这点活，本该是我还的。: Your grand-master carried me through the flood. This little job is the least I owe.
lines.屋顶我又上去看了一遍，结实着呢。: I went up and checked the roof again — solid as can be.
lines.瓦匠这行，最怕屋子没人住。你们住着，我就高兴。: A tiler's worst fear is an empty house. As long as you live in it, I'm happy.
lines.旧弟子房那边，好些年没人住了，灰都积了一指厚。: Nobody's lived in the old disciples' room for years. The dust is a finger thick.
lines.买把新扫帚、打点灯油、再补补窗纸，{0} 文就够。: A new broom, some lamp oil, fresh window paper — {0} coins will do.
lines.收拾出来，以后门里来了新弟子，也有个落脚的地方。: Tidy it up, and new disciples will have somewhere to stay.
lines.花 {0} 铜钱整理旧弟子房？: Pay {0} coins to tidy the old disciples' room?
lines.嗯，等你手头宽裕些再说。屋子跑不了。: Mm, when you've got a bit more to spare. The room isn't going anywhere.
lines.不够就先攒着，我这把扫帚，天天都在。: Not enough? Save up. My broom and I are here every day.
lines.瞧瞧，蛛网扫了，被褥铺上了，灯也点上了。: Look — cobwebs swept, bedding laid out, lamp lit.
lines.跟新的一样！就等师弟师妹们来了。: Good as new! Just waiting for new juniors to arrive.
lines.（眯着眼笑）好些年没见那扇窗亮过灯了。: (smiling, eyes crinkled) Haven't seen a light in that window for years.
lines.那屋子亮堂了，我夜里守门，心里也踏实。: With that room lit up, I feel easier keeping watch at night.
lines.招弟子的事不急。先把屋子备好，人自然会来。: No rush to recruit. Get the room ready and people will come.
lines.{0}，你看这灶台，裂了好几道缝，一烧火烟就往屋里倒。屋顶也漏。: {0}, look at this stove — cracked all over. Light a fire and the smoke pours inside. And the roof leaks.
lines.要是修好了，我就在门口摆个小摊卖馒头，每天还能给门里挣几个铜钱。: If it were fixed, I'd set up a little bun stall out front and earn the sect a few coins every day.
lines.修灶台、补屋顶、再搭个摊子，一共要 {0} 文。: Fixing the stove, patching the roof and building a stall comes to {0} coins.
lines.花 {0} 铜钱修厨房、开小食摊？: Pay {0} coins to fix the kitchen and open a food stall?
lines.行，钱攒够了再来。我这馒头，可等着出笼呢。: All right, come back when you've saved enough. My buns are waiting to be steamed.
lines.不够啊？不急，去练武场试试身手，师父说那块木牌底下有赏钱。: Not enough? No rush. Go test yourself at the training yard — Master says there's prize money by that sign.
lines.灶膛不倒烟了，屋顶也不漏了！: No more smoke from the stove, no more leaks from the roof!
lines.门口的摊子也搭好了。往后每天辰时（{0} 点）收一回钱，记到门里账上。: The stall out front is ready too. Every morning at {0} o'clock the takings go into the sect's books.
lines.那我每天早上都来闻闻馒头香。: Then I'll come smell the buns every morning.
lines.小食摊生意还不错。每天早上 {0} 点，钱就记到门里账上。: The food stall is doing well. Every morning at {0} o'clock the money goes into the sect's books.
lines.馒头刚出笼，香吧？可不许偷吃，留着卖钱。: Fresh from the steamer — smells good, huh? No sneaking any, they're for selling.
lines.练武场那块木牌，是梅花桩试炼。走得快、躲得巧，名望自会来。: That sign in the training yard is the Plum Post Trial. Move fast, dodge smart, and Renown will follow.
lines.门里的屋子，也该修一修了。老周、老伯、厨娘，都等着你拿主意。: The sect's buildings need mending too. Old Zhou, Old Uncle and Auntie Cook are all waiting on your call.
lines.钱要花在刀刃上。先修哪一处，你自己定。: Spend coins where they count. Which to fix first is up to you.
lines.梅花桩试炼：桩一根根亮起，依次踩上去。小心转动的木人桩，闪避可穿过。: Plum Post Trial: posts light up one by one — step on each in turn. Watch the spinning dummies; dodge to pass through them.
lines.限时 {0} 秒。{1} 秒内为金，{2} 秒内为银，{3} 秒内为铜。: Time limit {0} s. Gold within {1} s, Silver within {2} s, Bronze within {3} s.
lines.床铺都铺好了被褥，干干净净的。就等新弟子来了。: Every bed is made, clean and neat. Just waiting for new disciples.
lines.灶台补好了，火苗旺旺的，一点不倒烟。厨娘说，火旺了，日子也旺。: The stove is mended, the fire burning bright with no smoke. Auntie Cook says a lively fire means a lively life.
lines.灵猴门，猴子！嘻嘻，追得上我，算你本事！: Spirit Monkey Sect, Monkey! Hee hee — catch me if you can!
lines.太慢啦太慢啦！回去多蹦跶几天再来。: Too slow, too slow! Go hop around a few more days and come back.
lines.哎哟哟……你这闪身，比我们门里的师兄还滑溜。: Ow ow... your dodging is slipperier than my own senior's.
lines.铁牛帮，牦牛。我只会往前撞，接得住就算你赢。: Iron Ox Gang, Yak. All I do is charge. Take it, and you win.
lines.站不稳，就别上台。: If you can't keep your footing, stay off the stage.
lines.哞……让开了还能打回来，佩服。: Moo... stepped aside and still hit back. Respect.
lines.青蛇派，蛇。嘶——你打得中我的影子吗？: Green Snake School, Snake. Sss— can you even hit my shadow?
lines.嘶……出手太直了，打不中的。: Sss... your strikes are too straight. They'll never land.
lines.嘶……绕到我背后？好眼力。这一届，你是魁首。: Sss... slipped behind me? Sharp eyes. This tournament is yours.
lines.比武大会 · 第 {0} 届：今日午时至酉时报名，报名费 {1} 文。三轮闯关：: Martial Tournament · No. {0}: sign up today from noon to 18:00, entry fee {1} coins. Three rounds: Spirit Monkey Sect, Iron Ox Gang, Green Snake School.
lines.点到为止：生命掉到两成就算输。两轮之间回 {0} 点生命。头一回夺魁赏 {1}: Friendly bouts: drop to 20% HP and you lose. You heal {0} HP between rounds. First title pays {1} coins, then {2} each time.
lines.交 {0} 文报名比武大会？: Pay {0} coins to enter the tournament?
lines.选哪种难度？（只算这一届，报名费都是 {0} 文）: Which difficulty? (This tournament only; the fee is {0} coins either way)
lines.本届比武大会你已经上过台了。今天是第 {0} 天。: You've already fought in this tournament. Today is day {0}.
lines.比武大会告示：每 {0} 天一届，午时至酉时在此报名。今天是第 {1} 天。: Tournament notice: held every {0} days, sign up here from noon to 18:00. Today is day {1}.
lines.报名费还差一点……先去攒攒铜钱吧。: Not quite enough for the fee... save up some coins first.
lines.{0}，山门外有人想拜师！一个毛头小子，天刚亮就在石阶下候着了。: {0}, someone at the gate wants to become a disciple! A young lad — he's been waiting by the steps since dawn.
lines.好些年没人上门拜师了……你快去瞧瞧吧。: Nobody's come asking to join in years... go have a look.
lines.（搓着手）请、请问，这里就是山上的那个门派吗？: (wringing his hands) Ex-excuse me, is this the sect on the mountain?
lines.山下都在传，说这里又有人练武了，屋子也修得亮亮堂堂的。: Everyone below says people are training here again, and the buildings are all fixed up and bright.
lines.我力气不大，可我跑得快，什么活都肯干！求您收下我吧！: I'm not strong, but I'm fast, and I'll do any work! Please take me in!
lines.收下这个少年当弟子？（每天伙食费 {0} 文）: Take this youngster as a disciple? (Upkeep {0} coins a day)
lines.真、真的？谢谢师兄！我这就把行李搬进旧弟子房！: R-really? Thank you, Senior Brother! I'll move my things into the old disciples' room right away!
lines.以后你就是师弟了。有活儿的时候，我来找你。: From now on you're my Junior Brother. When there's work, I'll come find you.
lines.是！师兄吩咐什么，我就干什么！: Yes! Whatever you say, Senior Brother!
lines.那……我就在这儿等着。您想好了，再来告诉我。: Then... I'll wait right here. Tell me when you've decided.
lines.您……想好了吗？我还在这儿等着呢。: Have you... decided? I'm still waiting here.
lines.太好了！谢谢师兄！我这就把行李搬进旧弟子房！: Wonderful! Thank you, Senior Brother! I'll move my things into the old disciples' room right away!
lines.嗯，我不急。山门外的风景也挺好看的。: Mm, I'm in no hurry. The view outside the gate is nice.
lines.跟师弟说什么？: What do you say to Junior Brother?
lines.好嘞！明天起我去厨房给厨娘打下手，小食摊一天能卖 {0} 文！: You got it! From tomorrow I'll help Auntie Cook in the kitchen — the stall can make {0} coins a day!
lines.陪练？好！明天起我就在练武场等师兄，一天陪您过一回招。: Sparring? Great! From tomorrow I'll wait for you in the training yard — one bout a day.
lines.打扫交给我！明天起院子里一片落叶都不留。: Leave the sweeping to me! From tomorrow not a single leaf stays in the yard.
lines.我已经在干这个啦，师兄放心。: I'm already on it, Senior Brother. Don't worry.
lines.师兄！今天有什么活要我干吗？: Senior Brother! Any work for me today?
lines.师兄，我在厨房给厨娘打下手呢，馒头蒸得可香了！: Senior Brother, I'm helping Auntie Cook in the kitchen — the buns smell amazing!
lines.师兄，今天还练吗？我准备好了！: Senior Brother, are we training today? I'm ready!
lines.今天已经练过啦……腿还酸着呢，明天再来！: We already trained today... my legs are still sore. Tomorrow!
lines.院子我一早就扫过了，落叶都堆到墙角啦。: I swept the yard first thing — the leaves are all piled by the wall.
lines.师兄吩咐的活，我明天一早就去！: I'll start the job you gave me first thing tomorrow!
lines.这件旧练功服是旧弟子房里的，有点大，袖子挽两道就好了。: This old training robe was in the disciples' room. It's a bit big, but rolling the sleeves twice works.
lines.厨娘的馒头真好吃……我每天只吃一个，伙食钱可不能白花。: Auntie Cook's buns are so good... I only eat one a day — can't waste the food money.
lines.听说村口有比武大会，等我练好了，也想上台试试！: I heard there's a tournament at the village gate. When I'm good enough, I want to try it too!
lines.老伯说，以前门里的弟子能站满一院子。以后会的吧？: Old Uncle says the disciples used to fill the whole yard. It'll be like that again, right?
lines.哎呀，又输了……师兄好厉害！: Aw, lost again... you're amazing, Senior Brother!
lines.我看见您身上没发红，还以为……原来是我太慢了。: I saw you weren't glowing red, so I thought... turns out I was just too slow.
lines.我、我赢了？师兄是让着我吧！: I-I won? You let me win, didn't you!
lines.嘿嘿，今天总算碰到您一下了。: Hehe, I finally landed a hit on you today.
lines.生命 +{0}，准备下一轮: HP +{0} — get ready for the next round
lines.山门外好像来了一个少年: A youngster seems to have come to the gate
lines.比武大会报名中：今天（第 {0} 天）午时至酉时: Tournament sign-up open: today (day {0}), noon to 18:00
lines.瓦被山贼藏进后山了？……竹林那条小路，好多年没人走了。: The bandits hid the tiles on the back hill? ...Nobody has walked that bamboo path in years.
lines.盐买回来啦？好孩子。去后山小心点，林子里湿，别摔着。: Got the salt? Good boy. Careful on the back hill — the grove is damp, don't slip.
lines.听说你一个人把山贼打跑了？……行啊你。哼，我才不羡慕。: I hear you ran off the bandits all by yourself? ...Not bad. Hmph, not that I'm jealous.
lines.（小声）下次带上我。: (quietly) Take me with you next time.
lines.先去墙角拿抹布: Grab the rag in the corner first
lines.屋顶漏下的雨水，一滴一滴落进床边的木桶。桶里的水越来越满。: Rain leaks through the roof, drop by drop, into the bucket by the bed. The bucket keeps filling.
lines.木桶满了，水漫出来，在地上淌开一大滩。: The bucket overflows, spreading a big puddle across the floor.
lines.又漏了。今天得找人把屋顶补一补。: Leaking again. Someone has to patch that roof today.
lines.师兄的床又空了，被子都没叠。: Senior Brother's bed is empty again — he didn't even fold his quilt.
lines.先把地上的水擦干，不然要渗到床底下去了。: Better mop up the water before it seeps under the bed.
lines.墙角有抹布。（WASD 移动，E 查看，Esc 查看全部按键）: There's a rag in the corner. (WASD move, E look, Esc all keys)
lines.抹布……拧一拧还能用。: A rag... still usable if I wring it out.
lines.走到水渍旁边，按 E 擦干。: Walk to the puddle and press E to wipe it.
lines.……好了，干了。顺手把桶里的水也倒掉。: ...There, dry. Might as well empty the bucket too.
lines.{0}把木桶里的水倒掉，放回原处。屋顶还在滴，桶又开始接水。: {0} empties the bucket and puts it back. The roof still drips; the bucket starts filling again.
lines.咦，桌上好像有张字条。: Huh, there's a note on the table.
lines.「醒了来练武场。输的刷锅。——师兄」: "Come to the training yard when you're up. Loser washes the pots. — Senior Brother"
lines.……他怎么知道输的一定是我。: ...How does he know I'll be the loser?
lines.一个洞滴进桶里，一个洞正对着师兄的枕头。怪不得他今天起这么早。: One hole drips into the bucket, the other right onto Senior Brother's pillow. No wonder he got up so early.
lines.师兄说这叫\"以静制动\"。我觉得这叫穷。: Senior Brother calls it "stillness overcomes motion." I call it being broke.
lines.打开衣柜，里面叠着几件衣服。: You open the wardrobe. A few clothes are folded inside.
lines.两件换洗的练功服，一件比一件旧。: Two spare training robes, each older than the last.
lines.最底下那件，补丁是师父亲手缝的。针脚歪歪扭扭的……师父的剑法可比针线活好多了。: The one at the bottom was patched by Master himself. The stitches are crooked... his swordplay is far better than his sewing.
lines.还有一件小时候的衣服，袖子短得只到胳膊肘了。一直没舍得扔。: And a robe from when I was little — the sleeves only reach my elbows now. Never had the heart to throw it out.
lines.哟，醒啦？我还以为你被雨水泡发了，正打算捞起来晒晒。: Oh, you're up? I thought the rain had soaked you soggy — I was about to fish you out and hang you to dry.
lines.漏就漏呗，咱门派最不缺的就是\"透气\"。来来来，先陪师兄过两招，活动活动筋骨。: So it leaks. If there's one thing our sect has plenty of, it's "fresh air." Come on, spar with me a bit and loosen up.
lines.好，这次我一定赢你。: Fine. This time I'll beat you for sure.
lines.口气不小！输了的人刷一个月的锅。: Big talk! Loser washes the pots for a month.
lines.空着肚子才身轻如燕——不对，是饿得发飘。来吧！: An empty stomach makes you light as a swallow — no wait, light-headed. Come on!
lines.记住咱家功夫的要诀：别跟人硬碰。看我身上发红、头上冒\"!\"，就闪开，闪完马上: Remember the secret of our kung fu: never trade blows head-on. When I glow red with a "!" over my head, dodge — then strike back right away.
lines.J 攻击，空格闪避。闪避成功后马上按 J 是\"反击\"；贴着对手闪避会绕到他背: J attacks, Space dodges. Press J right after a good dodge to Counter; dodging close to a foe slips you behind him.
lines.哎哎哎，停！停！……行啊，刚才那一下闪身绕背，有点师父的味道了。: Hey hey, stop! Stop! ...Not bad. That dodge around my back had a bit of Master's style.
lines.（小声）锅还是我来刷吧，别告诉师父我输了。: (quietly) I'll wash the pots. Just don't tell Master I lost.
lines.去正殿吧，师父一早就在找你。: Head to the Main Hall. Master's been looking for you since dawn.
lines.哈哈，又是我赢！不过你刚才闪那一下挺快，就是闪完忘了还手。: Ha! I win again! Your dodge was quick, though — you just forgot to hit back.
lines.没事，打多了就会了。想再来随时找我。去正殿吧，师父一早就在找你。: Don't worry, you'll get it with practice. Find me anytime for another round. Now go to the Main Hall — Master's been looking for you since dawn.
lines.师父找你呢，别磨蹭。我？我在想下山以后先吃什么。: Master wants you, don't dawdle. Me? I'm thinking about what to eat first when I go down the mountain.
lines.屋顶的事，我听见了——整夜都听见了。: I heard about the roof. Heard it all night long.
lines.山下的瓦匠老周欠咱们一个人情。你下山一趟，请他上山补屋顶。: Old Zhou the tiler, down below, owes us a favor. Go down the mountain and ask him to come fix the roof.
lines.很多年前的事了。那时候山门还热闹，山下的人有难，都往这儿跑。: That was many years ago. Back then this gate was lively — whenever folk below were in trouble, they ran up here.
lines.先去厨房，问问厨娘还缺什么，顺路一起带回来。: Stop by the kitchen first and ask Auntie Cook what she needs. Bring it back on the way.
lines.师父，以前的门派是什么样的？: Master, what was the sect like back then?
lines.（停了一下）等你再长大些，我慢慢讲给你听。今天先把屋顶补上。: (a pause) When you're older, I'll tell you all of it. Today, the roof.
lines.嗯。路上小心，最近山路不太平。: Mm. Be careful — the mountain road hasn't been safe lately.
lines.先去厨房。厨娘要的东西别忘了，不然今晚只能喝清汤。: Kitchen first. Don't forget what Auntie Cook needs, or it's plain broth tonight.
lines.香炉里只剩半截香。师父说，香可以省，礼不能省。: Only half a stick of incense is left. Master says you can skimp on incense, never on respect.
lines.画像太旧了，只看得出一个模模糊糊的背影。师父每天都擦，可从来不说画的是谁。: The portrait is so old only a blurry figure seen from behind remains. Master dusts it every day but never says who it is.
lines.哎哟{0}，饭还没好呢，先去正殿，师父等着你。: Oh, {0} — food's not ready yet. Go to the Main Hall first, Master's waiting.
lines.要下山？正好！帮我带一包盐、一捆青菜回来。: Going down the mountain? Perfect! Bring me back a bag of salt and a bunch of greens.
lines.钱在这儿……就这些了，省着点花。: Here's the money... it's all we have, so spend it carefully.
lines.村口茶摊老板的青菜最便宜。跟他说是山上门派要的，他会多给一把。: The tea stall keeper at the village gate has the cheapest greens. Tell him it's for the sect on the mountain and he'll throw in extra.
lines.老一辈的交情呗。去吧去吧，早去早回。: Old friendships from the old days. Off you go — hurry back.
lines.盐、青菜，记住了没？还有，别跟你师兄学，路上不许偷吃。: Salt and greens, got it? And don't copy your Senior Brother — no snacking on the way.
lines.井绳又短了一截。再这样下去，得踮着脚打水了。: The well rope is shorter again. Keep this up and we'll be drawing water on tiptoe.
lines.萝卜是师兄种的，歪歪扭扭，跟他的字一样。: Senior Brother planted these radishes. Crooked, just like his handwriting.
lines.嗯，买菜，再请瓦匠老周来补屋顶。: Yes — to buy groceries and ask Old Zhou the tiler to fix the roof.
lines.老周啊……他小时候发大水，是你师祖背着他从水里蹚出来的。: Old Zhou... when he was little there was a great flood. Your grand-master carried him out of the water on his back.
lines.那时候山门前天天有人来道谢。现在嘛……就剩我这把扫帚天天来。: Back then people came to the gate every day to give thanks. Now... only my broom shows up every day.
lines.那门派后来为什么没落了？: So why did the sect decline?
lines.（扫地的手停了停）那一年……塌了半座藏经阁，走了好多人。剩下的事，你去问你师父吧: (his broom stops) That year... half the Scripture Library collapsed, and many people left. For the rest, ask your Master.
lines.以后我让门派重新热闹起来！: Someday I'll make this sect lively again!
lines.哈哈，好！那你先把今天的菜买回来。: Ha ha, good! Then start by buying today's groceries.
lines.山路上最近有生面孔转悠，当心点。: There've been strangers prowling the mountain road lately. Be careful.
lines.左边这只石狮缺了半只耳朵。老伯说，是师兄小时候爬上去摔下来时磕掉的。: The left stone lion is missing half an ear. Old Uncle says Senior Brother knocked it off falling from it as a kid.
lines.封条还是师父亲手贴的。我从小就被告诉，不许进去。: Master put up this seal himself. I've been told since I was little: never go in.
lines.……瓦砾底下压着几页书，字被雨泡开了，只认得出一个\"风\"字。: ...A few pages lie under the rubble. The rain has blurred the ink; only one word is legible: "Wind."
lines.站住！哪来的小兔子？: Halt! Where'd this little bunny come from?
lines.看这身破衣服，是山上那个穷门派的吧？兜里那几个铜板，交出来！: Look at those rags — you're from that broke sect up the mountain, huh? Hand over those coins!
lines.盐？哈哈！今天你就尝尝什么叫咸！: Salt? Ha! Today you'll find out how salty things can get!
lines.这身法……怎么跟传说里的一样……快、快跑！: That footwork... just like in the legends... r-run!
lines.（边跑边喊）瓦片的事不关我们事，是老大让藏的——: (shouting as they flee) The tiles weren't our idea — the boss made us hide them—
lines.……呼。刚才太着急了。师兄说过，别硬碰，看见\"!\"就闪，闪完马上还手。: ...Phew. I rushed it. Senior Brother said: don't go head-on — see the "!", dodge, then hit back.
lines.山上来的？是那个门派的小娃娃吧！: From up the mountain? You must be the little one from that sect!
lines.要一包盐、一捆青菜。: A bag of salt and a bunch of greens, please.
lines.青菜我多给你一把——当年你们门派的人帮我爹赶走过山贼，这人情我记一辈子。: I'll add an extra handful of greens — your sect once drove bandits off my father. I'll never forget it.
lines.说到山贼……刚才山路上有两个，跑之前说什么\"瓦片\"。: Speaking of bandits... there were two on the mountain road just now. They said something about "tiles."
lines.唉，就是他们！前几天把老周的一车瓦抢了，听说藏进了你们后山竹林里——那片林子密，: Ugh, that's them! They stole a whole cart of Old Zhou's tiles the other day, and hid them in the bamboo grove behind your mountain, they say. That grove is so thick, us villagers get lost in it.
lines.瓦找不回来，老周也没法上山干活啊。: Without those tiles, Old Zhou can't come fix anything.
lines.你身上这衣服的样式……我小时候见过！那些人走路轻飘飘的，一转身就不见了。: The cut of your clothes... I saw it as a child! Those people walked like they were floating, and vanished in a turn.
lines.后山竹林？我爷爷说过，林子里那块断碑是你们门派立的，碑上的字是\"给自己人指路的: The bamboo grove? My grandpa said the broken stele in there was put up by your sect — its words "show the way to our own."
lines.竹林里风大，跟着风走，别跟着眼睛走——我爷爷的原话，我也不懂。: "The grove is windy. Follow the wind, not your eyes." My grandpa's words — I never understood them.
lines.茶碗缺了口，茶倒是香的。: The teacup is chipped, but the tea smells lovely.
lines.好密的竹子……风一吹，到处沙沙响。: Such thick bamboo... the wind sets it rustling everywhere.
lines.那块就是村民说的断碑吧。: That must be the broken stele the villager mentioned.
lines.「风自东来，先拜青石，再拜苔石，后拜裂石。」: "Wind comes from the east. Bow first to the blue stone, then the mossy stone, last the cracked stone."
lines.青石、苔石、裂石……这附近有三块石头。: Blue stone, mossy stone, cracked stone... there are three stones nearby.
lines.靠近石头按 E\"拜一拜\"。: Go up to a stone and press E to bow.
lines.……不对。风不是往这边吹的。: ...No. The wind isn't blowing this way.
lines.村民说，跟着风走……竹叶刚才往哪边飘？: The villager said to follow the wind... which way did the bamboo leaves drift just now?
lines.找到了！老周的瓦，一片都没少。: Found them! Old Zhou's tiles — not a single one missing.
lines.……咦，瓦堆底下还压着一块旧布。: ...Huh, there's an old cloth under the pile.
lines.一块褪色的蓝布，上面绣着和{0}腰带一模一样的花纹。: A faded blue cloth, embroidered with the exact pattern on {0}'s sash.
lines.这花纹……和我的腰带一样？: This pattern... it's the same as my sash?
lines.（把布叠好，揣进怀里）: (folds the cloth and tucks it away)
lines.盐和青菜买了。瓦也找回来了，在后山竹林里，老周说明天一早就上山补屋顶。: Got the salt and greens. And I found the tiles in the bamboo grove — Old Zhou says he'll come fix the roof first thing tomorrow.
lines.竹林……你找到那块断碑了？: The grove... you found the broken stele?
lines.师父，瓦堆底下还有这个。: Master, this was under the tiles too.
lines.{0}，今天你下山一趟，看见了什么？: {0}, you went down the mountain today. What did you see?
lines.看见村里人还记得咱们。也看见……咱们连一片瓦都要去找回来。: That the villagers still remember us. And... that we have to go fetch back even a single tile.
lines.嗯。门派要重新站起来，有两条路。: Mm. There are two roads for a sect to stand again.
lines.一条，是去江湖上闯——比武、试炼、行侠，让天下人重新知道咱们的功夫。这叫名望。: One is to make your way in the martial world — tournaments, trials, heroic deeds — until all under heaven knows our kung fu again. That is Renown.
lines.一条，是把这个家一砖一瓦撑起来——修屋子、收弟子、接活计、种地开铺。这叫家业。: The other is to hold this home up brick by brick — mend the halls, take disciples, take on work, farm and open shops. That is Legacy.
lines.走哪条都行。两条都走得好，自然更好。等哪天，名望或家业撑得起这座山门——这掌门的: Either one. Walk both well, even better. And the day Renown or Legacy can hold up this gate — the seat of Sect Leader will pass to the one who comes after.
lines.{0}走出正殿。镜头停在师父身上。: {0} leaves the Main Hall. The camera stays on Master.
lines.（自言自语）……你们，也该回来看看了。: (to himself) ...It's time you all came back to see.
lines.师父刚才一个人在殿里站了好久……你又惹他了？: Master stood alone in the hall for ages just now... did you upset him again?
lines.那就好。走，吃饭去！今天的锅，我刷。: Good. Come on, let's eat! I'll do the pots today.
lines.木剑又扔在地上。师兄说这叫\"剑不离身\"——离身三尺也算。: His wooden sword is on the floor again. Senior Brother calls it "never parted from his blade" — three feet away still counts.
lines.被子底下压着半根萝卜……他又半夜偷吃。: Half a radish under the quilt... he's been sneaking midnight snacks again.
lines.一本《基础步法》，翻得都卷边了。另一本是师兄的《江湖奇闻》，夹着好几张糖纸。: A copy of "Basic Footwork," its pages dog-eared. The other is Senior Brother's "Tales of the Martial World," stuffed with candy wrappers.
lines.牌匾上的金字掉了一半，剩下的四个字我一直没认全。: Half the gold characters on the plaque have fallen off. I've never managed to read the four that remain.
lines.连正殿都漏……屋顶的事真不能再拖了。: Even the Main Hall leaks... the roof really can't wait any longer.
lines.粥是稀的，可是香。厨娘说，稀粥也要熬出米油来。: The porridge is thin, but fragrant. Auntie Cook says even thin porridge should be simmered till it's silky.
lines.米缸快见底了。……今天的盐，可千万别弄丢。: The rice jar is nearly empty... I'd better not lose today's salt.
lines.每个碗上都有几颗铜钉。厨娘说，碗碎了补一补，日子也是。: Every bowl has a few copper rivets. Auntie Cook says when a bowl breaks you mend it — same with life.
lines.一排空床铺，落满了灰。听老伯说，以前这里住满了人，夜里打呼噜能把屋顶震响。: A row of empty beds, thick with dust. Old Uncle says this place was once full — the snoring at night could rattle the roof.
lines.墙上的名牌大多摘了，只剩几块，字也看不清了。: Most of the name plates on the wall are gone. The few left are too faded to read.
lines.这件比我的还旧……不知道是哪位师兄留下的。: This one's even older than mine... I wonder which senior left it behind.
lines.扫帚、锄头、旧兵器……都落了一层灰。: Brooms, hoes, old weapons... all under a layer of dust.
lines.这面锣是以前门派开饭时敲的。现在开饭，靠厨娘喊。: This gong used to call the sect to meals. Now Auntie Cook just shouts.
lines.J 连按两下，第二下更重（8 + 12）。: J twice; the 2nd hit is heavier (8 + 12).
lines.敌人发红、头顶出“!”时闪开就是“看破”；0.8 秒内还手，整套伤害 ×1.5。: Dodge a red "!" attack, then hit within 0.8 s: ×1.5.
lines.朝 2 格内的敌人闪避，会绕到它背后。: Dodge into a foe (2 tiles) to get behind it.
lines.闪避后 0.6 秒内按 J，冲向 3 格内最近的敌人出手；看破后追击也算反击。: J within 0.6 s of a dodge dashes at the nearest foe (3 tiles).
lines.在练武场找师兄按 E；任一方生命降到 20% 就结束，双方回满。: E by Senior Brother; ends at 20% HP, then both heal.
lines.脱离战斗、5 秒没受伤后，每秒回 3 点。: Unhurt for 5 s out of combat: +3 HP a second.
lines.山路上的狼和野猪走近就开打；被打倒在山门外复活，山贼回原位。: They attack up close; if beaten, you revive at the gate.
lines.左上角的圆以你为中心，星星在圆边上指方向；挡住人时会变透明。: Centered on you; the rim star points the way.
lines.序章结束后师父给本钱 {0}。显示在生命条旁边，门派簿里也看得到。: Master gives {0} after the prologue; shown by your HP.

lines.限时 {0} 秒：{1} 秒内金、{2} 秒内银、{3} 秒内铜。每种评价第一次: Gold ≤ {1} s, Silver ≤ {2} s, Bronze ≤ {3} s. New ranks pay coins + Renown; repeats {4}.
lines.生命降到 {0}% 或超时就算这次失败（生命回满）；试炼中按 Esc 可以放弃。: Time-out or {0}% HP fails the run. Esc to quit. No regen.
lines.找老周（屋顶 {0}）、老伯（旧弟子房 {1}）、厨娘（厨房 {2}）按 E；钱: Roof {0} (Old Zhou), old room {1} (Old Uncle), kitchen {2} (Auntie Cook). +Legacy.
lines.厨房修好后门口开小食摊，每天辰时（{0} 点）收入 {1} 铜钱。: A fixed kitchen opens the stall: {1} coins each morning.
lines.自动保存（剧情、修缮、试炼、收钱、进出门）。启动画面“继续游戏”接着玩。: Autosaves often. Use Continue on the title screen.

lines.连打三轮：猴子、牦牛、蛇。生命掉到 {0}% 就输，两轮之间回 {1} 点。比赛: Monkey, Yak, Snake. Out at {0}% HP; +{1} HP between rounds. Esc, Q: forfeit.
lines.旧弟子房整理好，名望或家业到 {0} 格，第二天辰时山门外会来一个少年。收下后每: Tidy old room + {0} Renown or Legacy: a youngster comes. Upkeep {1}/day.
lines.找师弟按 E 派活，第二天辰时起生效：帮厨（小食摊每天 {0} 文，要先修好厨房: Kitchen: stall {0}/day. Sparring: win +{1}, {2} wins = Renown +1. Sweep: {3} days = Legacy +1.
lines.村口小广场。最多 {0} 条悬赏、{1} 条委托；放弃不罚。: Village square. Up to {0} bounty, {1} errands; quit freely.
lines.第 {0} 天辰时贴第一条：黄鼠狼（{1} 文、名望 +{2}）、狼山贼三人组（: From day {0}: Weasel {1} +{2}, Wolf trio {3} +{4}, Black Tiger {5} +{6}.
lines.接榜后恶人才出现（红点）。生命掉到 {0}% 判负：回满血、恶人还在、不扣钱；交: Appear once taken (red dot). Lose at {0}% HP: no cost, try again.
lines.三条揭完后每 {0} 天辰时贴一条（2 个狼山贼，{1} 文，不加名望），没接的: Then every {0} days: 2 wolf bandits, {1} coins.
lines.每天辰时贴 {0} 条，子时前交差，过时作废。送馒头 {1}、送信 {2}、找鸡: {0} a day at 08:00, due by midnight. Pay {2}–{5}; yellow dots guide you.
lines.擦干地上的水: Mop up the water on the floor
lines.看看桌上的字条: Read the note on the table
lines.去练武场找师兄: Find Senior Brother in the Training Yard
lines.去正殿见师父: See Master in the Main Hall
lines.去厨房找厨娘: See Auntie Cook in the kitchen
lines.从山门下山: Head down the mountain from the gate
lines.沿山路去村口: Follow the mountain road to the village
lines.去村口找茶摊老板: Find the tea stall keeper at the village gate
lines.去后山竹林找回瓦片: Recover the tiles in the bamboo grove
lines.会覆盖存档，确定吗？: This will overwrite your save. Continue?
lines.两条路都能让门派复兴，任意一条走到头，就能接任掌门。: Either road revives the sect; walk one to its end to lead it.
lines.师兄：好，想练了再来找我。: Senior Brother: Okay, come find me when you want to train.
lines.好身法！闪得准，还手也快。: Nice moves! Sharp dodge, quick counter.
lines.不错，这一招我服了。: Not bad. I'll give you that one.
lines.别急着出手，看我身上发红再闪。: Don't rush. Wait till I glow red, then dodge.
lines.闪开之后马上还手，才有机会。: Hit back right after dodging — that's your chance.
